title: One sealed journal snapshot: syntax, identity and static semantics
scope: Validate one exact sealed journal prefix and its effective static graph.
proposed_work_bound: O(H + V + E) logical traversal, plus G01 canonical ordering and I(V+E,Z_local); decoding/hash work proportional to supplied bytes. No per-assertion scan of every other assertion.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(bounded reader windows) RAM with O(H+V+E) disk index, or an explicitly materialized O(H+V+E) API; current content/auth fences not cached away.
semantic_requirement: Exact prefix/tail, referent identity, static acyclicity and lifecycle semantics retained.
proposed_witness: Chains in both orders, stars, independent edges and many uses of one state; count row/edge visits and reject cycles, changed bytes and temporal conflicts.

title: Append/correction histories and online validation
scope: Sequence of accepted journal appends/corrections, including when each prefix must be valid.
proposed_work_bound: Immutable framing/intake O(total newly supplied bytes/records). Static final-view validation uses G21. For arbitrary online edge insertions/corrections requiring immediate global validity: NO claimed aggregate O(H+V+E) until an algorithm and acceptance-boundary proof exists; proposed fallback per distinct required snapshot O(H_i+V_i+E_i) is explicit, not described as linear in final size.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded intake and durable indexes; corrections may touch genuinely affected dependents. No state-sized reserialization just to checkpoint.
semantic_requirement: Do not move cycle rejection from required acceptance to finalization for speed. Repeated internal calls do not become 'new required snapshots' to excuse redundant work.
proposed_witness: Adversarial insertion/retraction order and repeated unaffected appends; track per-prefix and total work separately; required design decision before freezing an end-to-end claim.

title: Static cross-journal corpus and external-reference validation
scope: Validate one exact selected set of sealed journals and its cross-journal graph.
proposed_work_bound: O(H + V + E) visits plus G01/index overhead; each external edge resolved a bounded number of times and topological elimination does not repeatedly scan the remaining graph.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(V+E) working index, permitted on disk; no recursive stack proportional to unbounded depth.
semantic_requirement: All external anchors/types and selected-prefix references exact; detect missing references and cycles without provider discovery.
proposed_witness: Disjoint pairs, reverse chain, deep DAG, shared roots and explicit cycle; source-driven edge/SQL work tests plus integrated archive-only check.

title: Selected member-history closure
scope: Resolve bound/retained histories for one exact member selection; batch selection is one operation, not N unrelated cold operations.
proposed_work_bound: O(H_U + V_U + E_U + selected members + Q_explicit) logical work over the union of required history; exact shared prefixes/dependencies indexed once per qualification scope. Ordered indexing cost explicit.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(H_U+V_U+E_U) disk state with bounded RAM and read windows; eviction does not change semantic completeness or create an unannounced collection ceiling.
semantic_requirement: Recorded history is not causal attribution; omitted/imported extents, forks and corrections remain exact; no current permission cached.
proposed_witness: Many members sharing history, disjoint histories, cycles/missing imports, warm/cold/evicted working sets; count queue scans, bytes validated and unique dependency visits.

title: Published provenance reads and claimed history transfer
scope: Get a selected binding or export/transfer an authorized history union.
proposed_work_bound: Prepared binding lookup O(log Z + returned metadata); first cold index preparation O(N+O+H) explicitly once per session/snapshot. Whole selected export O(H_U + E_U + Q + bytes transferred), not O(N*archive descriptors).
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded network/scratch windows; bounded immutable caches with correct bypass; independent live authorization per request.
semantic_requirement: Exact selected-copy/incarnation/root and claimed scope retained; no public fresh-read obligation silently removed by local reuse.
proposed_witness: Single-member lookup against growing unrelated inventory; whole export with repeated shared prefixes and late revocation; count descriptor/byte visits.

title: Discovery build/rebuild and shared-history representation
scope: Construct a query-equivalent derived discovery generation from exact archive evidence.
proposed_work_bound: Target O(H + V + E + N + A_direct + shared-group links) logical construction for an explicitly declared compact/factorable index profile; arbitrary reachability/query profiles remain G28. Here A_direct means directly attributed assertion links, not all transitive member-history pairs. Construction plus corresponding indexed/order work. An N-by-shared-assertion materialized Cartesian product is NOT a necessary-input dimension. Explicitly requested dense output can cost O(Q).
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded RAM and transactions; compact durable index O(unique assertions + explicit scopes/edges + members), except genuine independently required dense relationships.
semantic_requirement: Preserve all member/input-history/collection/recorded-history query results, ordering, provenance and archive identity. The compact extraction/dataset/read-generation identity change is specifically approved; edit the Alembic v1_0001 current baseline in place, retaining forward-only revision machinery; no migration or compatibility layer from abandoned pre-v1 layouts. Old cursors conflict/restart; preserve non-rebuildable operational state.
proposed_witness: Independent, fully shared and partially shared histories; fixed unique corpus with increasing member count; compare all scopes/query results before/after and measure rows/bytes, not only batched insert count.

title: Catalog/inventory point access and complete pagination
scope: Exact member/collection lookup, ordered page and complete enumeration.
proposed_work_bound: Point O(log Z + returned bytes); indexed page O(log Z + p + page bytes). Complete keyset traversal O(N + returned bytes + ceil(N/p)*log Z); no OFFSET-prefix rescans. Arbitrary filters use a separately declared scan/query profile.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(page + cursor/snapshot metadata) working memory; slow consumer releases DB snapshot/connection under declared exact-read lifetime.
semantic_requirement: Authorization, exact selector/order and final completeness remain; an empty page is not assumed proof of completion.
proposed_witness: Many small pages over a fixed exact inventory, late-page mutations/expiry and slow clients; count rows examined across full traversal.

title: Discovery/text/predicate query execution
scope: Named indexed lookups versus an explicitly scoped full search.
proposed_work_bound: Indexed equality/prefix profile O(log Z + candidate postings necessary for that declared profile + Q + returned bytes); full text/unindexed fixed predicate O(D_scan + candidates + Q), with S(Q) only if required order lacks an index. No generic O(Q) claim for arbitrary joins/negation/count/sort.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded result pages with spill for declared sort/join; full exact count charged to actual indexed/scan domain, not a constant.
semantic_requirement: Define query cost classes by supported semantics, not chosen inefficient plan. No use of 'candidate count' to relabel a gratuitous cross product. Exact scopes and ambiguity preserved.
proposed_witness: Zero-result and sparse-result large domains; ambiguous shared history; matching counts unchanged; plan and examined-row tests on supported DBs.

title: Independent archive-only recovery and rebuild
scope: Recover complete or selected data/provenance from archive/key material without Riverhog services.
proposed_work_bound: Cold descriptor verification O(O+metadata bytes); whole recovery O(B+N+H+V+E+O) visits plus explicit crypto, ordering and index work. Selected reads add only touched payload units after the stated bootstrap; not O(journals*descriptors).
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded streams and disk-backed indexes; storage O(recovered output + required metadata indexes), not all payload in memory.
semantic_requirement: No dependence on server/client/database implementations, no provider listing as archive authority; root/terminator and every touched segment verified.
proposed_witness: Many tiny journals and one large segmented file; cold recovery, partial selection, wrong key, missing terminal, truncation and process restart.
